source: Module 5-1 gate adapted to workpiece_2 single-view raised-structure geometry
description: workpiece_2's raised reverse face has less single-view CAD overlap than Module 5-1's legacy part. Require jointly: fitness >= 0.60, depth match >= 0.70, and ICP RMSE <= 6 mm. A rejected pose may still be visualized but must not be sent to Planner.
